Hi Jimmy,

Thanks for following up, and happy to give you where things stand today.

Your order Shop···· is paid and waiting on stock. The date on your order for the Magic M. 40T is October 31, and I want to be straight with you: the units for the US warehouse are still being built at the factory, so I don't yet have a confirmed date for them landing with us. I'd rather tell you that than guess a date.

The good news is your order number sits inside the first US shipment's coverage, so you're on that one. You can watch it move from the factory to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA goes out in the same box. As soon as the label is printed you'll get the tracking number by email at this address.

Thanks for your patience, Jimmy.

Hi Jimmy,

Thanks for checking in, and sorry you are still waiting on this one.

Here is where it stands today. Your Magic M. 40T units left the factory on November 12, as Georges said they would, and they are now in transit to our US warehouse in Chattanooga. The ship date now on your order is November 30, so that is the date to work from for your unit going out to you.

You have not seen shipping info yet because nothing has left our warehouse: the label and tracking number are only created once the stock is checked in and your box is packed. That tracking comes to this email address automatically, so nothing for you to do.

You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA goes out in the same box.

Thanks for your patience, Jimmy.

Sarah
HeliumDeploy Support
